faqs.question: What is the invoice date and number?
faqs.answer: The invoice date is November 26, 2016, and the invoice number is 161126.

faqs.question: When is the payment due?
faqs.answer: Payment is due 30 days after the invoice date, which would be December 26, 2016.

faqs.question: Which bank should the payment be transferred to?

summary.title: Invoice for Prince Upgrades & Support
summary.long_summary: This document is an invoice issued by YesLogic Pty. Ltd., located at 7 / 39 Bouverie St, Carlton VIC 3053, Australia. The invoice is addressed to a customer whose name, street, postcode, city, and country are placeholders. It was issued on November 26, 2016, with invoice number 161126, and payment is due 30 days after the invoice date. The invoice details a single line item: "Prince Upgrades & Support" covering the period from November 26, 2016 to November 26, 2017, for a total amount of USD $950.00. The table also lists the total amount due, which matches the line item amount. The invoice includes payment instructions, directing the customer to transfer the USD $950.00 to Yes Logic Pty Ltd. The bank details provided are: Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA), BSB 063010 (and 063019), account number 13201652, SWIFT code CTBAAU2S, and bank address 231 Swanston St, Melbourne, VIC 3000, Australia. A note explains that Australian banks use BSB numbers instead of IBANs for international transfers. The invoice ends with the company website www.yeslogic.com.
